summaries.Romania: Romania's political crisis deepens as parties negotiate government formation with threats of parliamentary dissolution, while DNA corruption investigations intensify across multiple sectors including border control and defense contracting.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with AI-powered diagnostics and agentic platforms reshaping clinical operations, while regulatory scrutiny increases on patient advocacy group funding and pharmaceutical industry influence.
summaries.Tech: Apple's smart home ecosystem expands with HomeView, HomePod mini 2, and new Apple TV 4K featuring Siri AI, while AI safety concerns mount over model replication risks and emerging security vulnerabilities.

items.title: VIDEO Decizia luată de grupurile parlamentare ale PNL în privința Guvernului Niculescu: „Sunt peste 160 de zile de când avem guvern interimar”
items.snippet: Grupurile parlamentare ale PNL, reunite miercuri în ședință, au decis să voteze Guvernul Luca Niculescu, dar partidul să treacă în opoziție, a anunțat purtătorul de cuvânt al PNL, Ionel Bogdan. items.line: PNL decides to vote for Niculescu government while remaining in opposition—a critical move determining whether Romania can form a functioning executive after months of political paralysis.

items.title: Apple says beloved MacBook is now ‘obsolete,’ more products too
items.snippet:

items.line: Apple announces HomeView smart display ($299) with 7-inch screen, facial recognition for up to 6 users, and Siri AI—entering competitive smart home display market.

items.title: STAT+: FDA adcomm members’ ties to industry under scrutiny
items.snippet: New research found that nearly 40% of FDA advisory meetings held over a recent 20-year period included either a patient or consumer rep with active ties to an advocacy group…
items.line: FDA advisory committee analysis reveals nearly 40% of patient/consumer representatives have ties to pharma-funded advocacy groups—raising conflicts of interest in drug approval decisions.

items.title: STAT+: BlackRock to buy majority stake in Humana’s CenterWell clinics for $2.8 billion
items.snippet: Humana is swapping out private equity sponsors for its CenterWell Senior Primary Care clinics. Good bye, Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe. Hello, BlackRock.
items.line: BlackRock acquires majority stake in Humana's CenterWell clinics for $2.8B, signaling major private equity shift in primary care clinic ownership and operations.

 more…

items.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices
items.snippet: "Small weight-based replicators" could usher in a new generation of computer worms.
items.line: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices within months—creating new class of AI-powered computer worms threatening connected infrastructure.

items.title: FBI arrests OpenAI employee accused of planting hidden recording device in conference room
items.snippet: It's not clear exactly for what purpose the recording device was used, but FBI director Kash Patel said the scheme was to "capture sensitive communications about the company’s super intelligence technology."
items.line: FBI arrests OpenAI employee for planting hidden recording device in conference room to capture sensitive communications about superintelligence technology.

items.title: MedLife face un nou pas în dezvoltarea pediatriei private: Spitalul de Pediatrie devine Spitalul Copilului și Adolescentului și își extinde serviciile cu un nou centru de kinetoterapie pediatrică

items.title: Confido Health nabs $12.5M to scale agentic AI across PE-backed medical groups
items.snippet: The company secured a $12.5 million series A extension following its $10 million series A round announced in September to continue scaling an AI platform for end-to-end healthcare operations.
items.line: Confido Health raises $12.5M Series A extension for agentic AI platform automating end-to-end healthcare operations across PE-backed medical groups.
